question: How does emission display universal formhood through its cycle?
premises: Vital power operates in sacrifice and other rites.
It appears in rain, then in plants, then again in vital power, and then in offspring.
inference: Emission reveals universal formhood by circulating as the same vital power through ritual, nature, and progeny.
plain_english: In sacrifice and other rites, in rain, in plants, again in vital power, and then in offspring, the same power circulates. Thus emission takes on the form of the whole universe.
